title: SPIRIT OF DIWALI IN GIVING
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim celebrated its Diwali get-together under the inspiring theme “Diwali in Giving,” beautifully blending festive cheer, fellowship and meaningful community service.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim celebrated its Diwali get-together under the inspiring theme “Diwali in Giving,” beautifully blending festive cheer, fellowship and meaningful community service.
The evening was made truly special by the presence of 25 underprivileged children, who showcased their creativity by lighting innovative water-sensor diyas and delighted everyone with their dance and singing performances. They were gifted Diwali faral and bedsheets, spreading warmth and happiness during the festive season.
